title: ## Summary - Gallery videos on mobile were rendering as a blank box (only preload="metadata" was set, so no frame is guaranteed to draw until playback starts) - Extracted a poster frame from each of the 4 gallery videos and added it via the poster attribute on the corresponding <video> tag  ## Test plan - [x] Verified each generated poster image renders correctly - [ ] Confirm thumbnails display before playback on a real mobile device once deployed  🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)Add poster thumbnails to gallery videos
body: Mobile browsers were showing a blank box for videos with preload="metadata" until the user tapped play. Generate a poster frame from each gallery video and wire it up via the poster attribute so a thumbnail shows immediately.
